description:
Heyaa moon-goers! 

We're The Voyagers! Wanna land on the cheese wheel dangling above our heads? Wanna make sure you or your best robot friends land safe and sound? Well our website is just for you! 

Powered by sleep deprived coders and hours of heads banging against walls, we made Astropulse! 

Our team LOVES coding and tinkering with all kinds of stuff, hardware, software, app, websites. You name it, we make it! This year, we're dipping our feet into the fantasic realm of 3D! We learnt 3D modeling, simulations, and even data analysis and interpretation whist having lots of fun! 

If you are scientists or nerds who love the moon, come and take a look at our website, we are sure you'll absolutely love it. See you there! ❤️
